newsitem.title: UK: Carlton off, BZW says ad spending slows.
newsitem.headline: Carlton off, BZW says ad spending slows.

text.p: Shares in Carlton Communications fell on Monday after brokerage BZW turned cautious on future levels of advertising spending, dealers said.
Carlton's shares dropped 16p to 508-1/2p by 1200 GMT in volume of over 1.2 milion shares.
In a note to clients on Monday, BZW said growth in advertising spending would slow in 1998 but analysts at the brokerage said they still had a "buy" recommendation on the stock.
Dealers in the often volatile stock said sellers had emerged in an effort to "flatten positions" ahead of Carlton's interim results on Wednesday.
